अवे {c2c} P. [अव इ]
1 (a) To know,
understand, learn, perceive, be aware
of; अवैमि ते तस्यां सोदर्यस्नेहं Ś. 4;
अवैमि चैनामनघेति

. (b) To know,
look upon or consider, regard,
तदवैमि कैतवं

.
--2 To go or move away.
--3
To go to, approach (with acc.).
--4
To rush upon, come down upon
(Ved.) --Freq. or Pass. (अवेयते) To
beg pardon for, conciliate.

अवेत p. p.
1 Elapsed, past.
--2
Obtained, attained.
--3 Joined or
united with.

अवेक्ष् {c1c} A. [अव-ईक्ष्]
1 To look
at, perceive, observe, behold.
--2 To
aim at, have in view; योत्स्यमानानवेक्षेहं

; take into account or
consideration, have regard to; अवेक्ष्य
धातोर्गमनार्थमर्थविद्

; न हि कमलिनीं दृष्ट्वा ग्राहमवेक्षते
मतंगजः

(it may also mean
‘expect’ here); निद्रावशेन भवता
ह्यनवेक्ष्यमाणा

.
--3 To look to or
after, attend to; अवेक्षमाणं महतीं
मुहुर्मुहुः Śi. 1. 10.
--4 To take care of,
guard, watch over, protect;
वसुधेयमवेक्ष्यतां त्वया

.
--6 To look into or examine,
inspect; स कदाचिदवेक्षितप्रजः

अवेक्षक a.
1 Showing, showing
all round.
--2 Inspecting,
supervising; a superintendent.

1 Looking towards or at,
seeing.
--2 Guarding, watching over,
protection, taking care of,
attending to, supervision, inspection;
वर्णाश्रमावेक्षणजागरूकः

.
--3 Attention,
care, observation.
--4 Regarding,
considering; see अनवेक्षणं.

अवेक्षणीय pot. p. To be looked to
or respected, to be looked upon or
considered; तपस्विसामान्यमवेक्षणीया

1 Seeing, looking at.
--2
Attention, care, regard; लब्धं रक्षेदवेक्षया

; अत्रास्त्यवेक्षा त्वयि मे
Rām.
--3 Agreement, engagement.

अवेक्षितृ a. Looking at; thinking
of, regarding &c.

अवेणि a.
1 Not braided.
--2
Having no braid of hair.
--3 Not flowing
together or commingled (as the
waters of rivers).

अवेदयान a. Not knowing, not
ascertaining.

अवेद्य a.
1 Unknowable, secret.
--2 Unattainable.
--द्यः A calf.
--द्या
(A woman) not to be married;

आवेदनीय, --वेद्य pot. p.
1 To be
declared or reported.
--2 To be made
the subject of a plaint.

अवेल a.
1 Having no boundary
or limit, unlimited.
--2 Having no
time, untimely.
--लः Concealment
of knowledge.
--ला
1 Unfavourable
[]
time.
--2 Chewed betel (supposed
to be = अव+इला).

अवेष्टिः Ved. Expiation(of sins)
by sacrifices.

आवेदक a. Making known,
reporting, communicating.
--कः
1 One
who makes known, an informer.
--2
A suitor, plaintiff.

1 Communicating,
reporting, or addressing respectfully.
--2
Representation.
--3 Stating a
complaint (in law); राज्ञे कुर्यात् पूर्वमावेदनं
यः Nārada.
--4 A plaint.

आवेदनीय, --वेद्य pot. p.
1 To be
declared or reported.
--2 To be made
the subject of a plaint.

आवेदित p. p. Made known,
communicated &c.
--तः The person to
whom something is made known.
--तं That which is communicated.

आवेदिन् a.
1 Declaring,
announcing.
--2 Giving orders.

to enter or infuse
oneself into.
--2 Taking possession of,
influence, exercise; स्मय˚ influence of
pride

; so मदन˚, क्रोध˚, भय˚
&c.
--3 Intentness, devotedness to an
object, complete absorption in one
wish or idea.
--4 Pride, arrogance.
--5 Flurry, agitation, anger, passion;

.
--6 Demoniacal possession.
--7
Apoplectic or epileptic giddiness.

1 Entering, entrance.
--2
Demoniacal possession.
--3 Passion,
anger, fury.
--4 A manufactory,
work-shop;

.
--5 The disc
of the sun or the moon.
--6 A house,
dwelling.

आवेशिक a. (की f.) [आवेश-ठञ्]
1 Peculiar, one's own (असाधारण).
--2 Inherent.
--कः A guest, visitor.
--कं
1 Entering into.
--2 Hospitality.

; शोक˚, दुःख˚,
साध्वस˚ &c.
--2 Hurry, haste; Ś. 4.
--3 Agitation, regarded as one of
the 33 subordinate feelings.
--गी
N. of a tree (वृद्धदारकवृक्ष).

आवेष्टकः A wall, fence, an
enclosure.

1 Wrapping round, tying,
binding.
--2 A wrapper, an envelope.
--3 A wall, fence, enclosure.
